calls.thesis: Speculative long-distance play: AI data-center landlord with ~$36B of ~15-year leases signed; back-of-napkin ~$10-14B fair value vs ~$7B today. Easy DCA candidate for patient investors; spring releases when rent pulls ahead of the interest bill (~end 2026). Soften from his Oct 3 BUY.
calls.bull_case: Buildings come online on schedule and next leases reprice higher given power/permit scarcity.
calls.bear_case: Rent still ~$90M/year short of interest bill; ~20% short interest; 25% below the 200-day with more slide expected.

calls.thesis: 'No-brainer' data-center play, long-term money machine - but priced very high now, so slowly DCA.
calls.bear: Priced high now; expect an earnings-miss drop at some point.
calls.collab_byline: Investing Simplified - Professor G and BWB - Business With Brian
